1	# Build - notes
2	
3	A redesign of a design's Build page (`/f/:folder/d/:design/build`): today
4	`server/views/_build.eta`, fed by `buildView()` in `server/main.js`, with
5	stories made by templates in `server/backlog.js` (`storyMarkdown`,
6	`incrementStory`, `layoutsStory`) from `increment.js`'s diff. The route
7	carries `"from": "@app/server/views/_build"`. The fake design being built
8	is "Loan offers" in borrower-portal (Offers, Compare offers, Accept an
9	offer, plus "Across the design").
10	
11	Pages: Build (`build/page`, its list `build/_pages`); a page's story
12	(`/build/stories/:group`: `build/story`, `_stories`, `_story`,
13	`_story-edit`, the `_rewrite` modal); a build session
14	(`/sessions/:session`: `build/session`, its check `_check`, one screen
15	`_shot`, `_tally`, `_open-app`; `_chat`, `_transcript`, `_entry`,
16	`_composer` are a stand-in for the design page's chat). States: typical,
17	split and writing, not approved, building, no app, all built; each has a
18	build session (typical: mid-build, one differs, two not built; building:
19	the agent working, one doesn't render, the app stopped; no app: the app
20	stopped; all built: done). Events: `story-written`, `check-done`.
21	
22	## What was wrong with it
23	
24	- The story was raw Markdown in a read-only textarea behind "Copy as story".
25	- Stories were written for the server: route patterns, `POST … updates the
26	  record at …`, file paths; each card listed routes and "the design's view".
27	- Blockers (no app, not approved, behind main, building) were stacked cards.
28	- Old layout and ds/v1.
29	- Not only what differs from the app: `increment.js` compares with the same
30	  design on main, so a redesign of an app page (`"from": "@app/…"`) in a new
31	  design was "new" and got the whole page's story; a change on top of an
32	  unbuilt main design left the unbuilt part out; whole stories listed ported
33	  routes, built rules and every design-wide rule in every story.
34	
35	## Decisions

1	# Prelude Design System - notes
2	
3	Prelude's own design system: the vocabulary of Prelude's screens (folders,
4	designs, sessions, the design surface), drafted from what Prelude already ships:
5	`server/public/ds/v1/` (tokens, components, icons) and `server/public/prelude.css`
6	(Prelude's own patterns). Gallery: `screens/01-tokens`, `02-components`,
7	`03-guidelines`; `styles.css` is the gallery's own layout only.
8	
9	## Decisions
10	
11	- **Look unchanged.** Same OKLCH palette (warm neutrals, sienna accent), type
12	  scale, 4px space step, radii and shadows as ds/v1 - it's what Prelude looks like.
13	  Only change: light `--warn` darkened (0.6 → 0.55 L) so warn text reads on white.
14	- **Prelude's own patterns promoted to components**: list/item, menu, segmented
15	  (was `.mode-switch`), toolbar (`.design-bar`), panel (`.chat`/`.design`),
16	  notice (`.host-approval`, confirm cards), status + pulse, transcript, composer,
17	  prose (`.markdown`), empty, crumbs, disclosure, choices. Page layout
18	  (`.page`, `.workspace`, `.bar`) left out: it's the app shell's.
19	- **Compact controls by default.** ds/v1's default button was 3.25rem and primary
20	  4rem (mobile-sized), and Prelude overrode it everywhere with `.small` plus local
21	  heights. Now `.btn` = `--control-md` (2.5rem, same as inputs, so `.inline` lines
22	  up), `.small` = 2rem for toolbars, `.large` = 3.25rem. Primary is a colour, not a size.
23	- **Renames for clarity / one name per thing**: `.f`→`.label`, `.err`→`.error`,
24	  `.sec`→`.secondary`, `.rowbtns`→`.actions`, `.iconbtn`/`.icon-btn`→`.icon-btn`,
25	  `.hard`→`.danger`, `.linkish`→`.link-btn`, `.pill.ok/.bad`→`.good/.danger` (+`.warn`,
26	  `.accent`), `table.data`→`.table`, `.markdown`→`.prose`, `.area`→`.group-label`,
27	  `.span2`→`.wide`, `.kinds .check`→`.choices .choice`. Added `.hint`.
28	- **Layout primitives**: `.stack`, `.cluster`, `.grid`, `.split` (main + `.side`),
29	  `.center` (`.narrow`). Prelude had no general helpe

The check now has padding on every side, not just the right. Its contents were running into the panel's edges, the left as well as the right.

**Why:** the design system's panel body has no padding. That's on purpose for the design surface, which fills its panel edge to edge, but it was wrong for the check's list. Nothing in the system was meant for a padded panel, so I added a general option and used it.

- **Design system:** a new inset option for the panel body (`.panel-body.inset`), which keeps its contents a standard space in from the edges. I added it to the panel component's file, with an example in the components gallery and a line in the system's `NOTES.md` saying that Build needed it.
- **Build:** the check panel uses it (`prelude/build/views/build/session.eta:42`). A screen you open from the check loads into the same panel, so it gets the same padding.

I haven't looked at it in the preview, so it's worth a look to make sure the space looks right.

I've stopped the check panel scrolling sideways; it now scrolls only up and down. I haven't seen it in the preview, so please check it's gone.

**Why it happened:** list rows reach a little past their own edges, so the highlight when you point at a row lines up with the text around it. Before I added the padding, they ran past the panel's edge. With the padding, they still ran a little past where the browser lets content end before it allows sideways scrolling.

**The fix:** the padded panel body, the option I added last turn, no longer scrolls sideways (`overflow-x: hidden`). The highlight still shows in full, because it sits inside the padding, so nothing visible gets cut off. I made the change in the design system's panel component, so any padded panel gets it, and noted why in the system's `NOTES.md`.
